conventions: atlas owns money: charges, refunds, invoices, plans, taxes, receipts.
harbor owns the platform: outages, errors, latency, queues, and technical failures even when they involve payments or email delivery.
beacon owns identity and trust: accounts, credentials, sessions, permissions, and data exposure, including routine lockouts.
quill owns the product experience: feature requests, how-to questions, and documentation.
